notes: A concert stage players perform on is Entertainment's venue-stage and the Performance Venue preset - the answers confirm players get on the stage themselves, so the build is walkable rather than a SET, and Music & Audio does not route P5 here because a club is a room. Kept social-hub for the club floor the audience stands on and spawn-first-reveal so joining players face the stage, dropped the preset's spectator-bleachers because an indoor club floor is flat and raked tiers were never described, and used zone-graphics as the home for the requested house lights and rig, which is the only option that carries toggleable lighting and particle clusters. Decided without a user, since the prompt is thin: one compact indoor club venue with a raised stage and a flat standing floor, no separate backstage, so nothing pulls this off P0 - other players are the audience, so I did not add an ambient NPC crowd. The built-in music is an audio system with no geometry to place beyond the stage rig itself.
